VI.description: Returns the client area of the window hWnd through user32.dll GetClientRect (stdcall\2C called in any thread)\3A in CLIENT coordinates\2C so left and top are 0 and right and bottom are the width and height of the client area. The rectangle travels to the DLL as a RECT {LONG left\2C top\2C right\2C bottom}; right and bottom are exclusive. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.
